facts: Optimized Power BI semantic models using Tabular Editor 3 by removing unused measures, tables, and dependencies, improving report efficiency, maintainability, and migration readiness.
Supported SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA table migration using Airflow, Databricks, SQL, and Python, enabling data transformation, validation, and integration with reporting solutions.

Used OpenAI Codex and TMDL files to analyze Power BI report metadata, tables, relationships, dependencies, and business logic, supporting faster report mapping and migration from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA.
Applied LLM-assisted analysis to accelerate metadata review, dependency mapping, and technical investigation across complex BI assets.
Worked with business and technical stakeholders across Canada and US teams to understand reporting requirements, validate data logic, identify dependencies, and document migration-related findings.
Implemented dynamic Row-Level Security (RLS) using user-based access controls and security mapping tables, enabling secure self-service analytics across enterprise reporting environments.
Built data ingestion and transformation pipelines following Medallion Architecture using Databricks.
Built Spark/PySpark notebooks and orchestrated ETL workflows with Apache Airflow, automating data ingestion, transformation, and validation for enterprise-scale reporting solutions.

Built Power BI dashboards and reports to track social program results across 3,600 schools in Brazil, providing stakeholders with clear visibility into program performance, coverage, and impact indicators.

Worked with Oracle and PL/SQL packages to support ETL processes, business rule implementation, and data transformation routines, ensuring reliable data processing for analytics and reporting solutions.
Collaborated with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, validate calculations, and deliver reporting solutions aligned with operational and management needs.

Developed pixel-perfect paginated reports using Microsoft Report Builder, ensuring standardized layouts, accurate calculations, business rule compliance, and alignment with internal reporting requirements.

Implemented both Row-Level Security (RLS) and Object-Level Security (OLS) in Power BI semantic models using Tabular Editor 3, ensuring secure, role-based access to data across regions, business units, and sensitive reporting domains.
Developed Power BI solutions over datasets with 250M+ rows, using DirectQuery, optimized data models, and query reduction techniques to improve performance and usability.
Reduced Power BI capacity consumption by approximately 50% by optimizing the 10 heaviest reports using DAX Studio, incremental refresh, data model improvements, and ETL optimization.
Improved data models, DAX calculations, and ETL processes to increase report performance, reduce resource consumption, and improve user experience.
Worked with cloud-based data platforms and analytics environments, including Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, and AWS Athena, to support scalable reporting solutions.
Collaborated with commercial managers to establish performance metrics and business rules for sales representative reporting.
Implemented Row-Level Security (RLS) using Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD groups, enabling stakeholders to manage report access independently while ensuring secure and controlled data visibility.

Standardized and parameterized Power BI reports used across 50+ accounting clients, improving report consistency, scalability, and delivery efficiency through reusable layouts, data models, and business logic.

Developed BI solutions for an apparel manufacturing company, supporting collection planning based on material inputs and color availability, as well as management analysis through Power BI dashboards, SQL queries, and data transformation routines.
Worked with SQL, Oracle, and Power Query (M) to extract, transform, and structure data from different sources, ensuring reliable datasets for analytics and reporting solutions.
Translated business requirements into scalable reporting models, helping clients improve visibility into operational and management processes.
Implemented Row-Level Security (RLS) in Power BI to control data access by role, ensuring secure and appropriate data visibility for each user.
